episodes.title: El juego de Lucy
episodes.summary: Mourning Lucy's death, Greta meets the enigmatic Will Tucker, a stranger bearing a game left by her sister — but the only way to play is to trust him.

episodes.title: Subo la apuesta
episodes.summary: Guided by Lucy to look for life's beauty, Greta and Will embark on her first-ever trip abroad, and a storm forces them to share a hotel room overnight.

episodes.title: Y tiro porque me toca
episodes.summary: Will halts progress on Lucy's game to sort through his conflicted feelings. Greta reconnects with her father and tries to help her mother move forward.

episodes.title: All In
episodes.summary: No longer able to hide his past, Will comes clean about his troubled youth — and the tragic reason Lucy chose him to guide Greta through the game.

episodes.title: Tocado y hundido
episodes.summary: Greta takes a break from the Map of Longing after Will's confession to work on herself and begin planning for a future that belongs only to her.

episodes.title: Vuelve a la casilla de salida
episodes.summary: Lucy's final letters leave Greta in uncharted territory with Will, but give her the courage to embrace life — starting with a trip close to her heart.
